sources.title: Nasdaq100 scope and accessible-research limits
sources.policy_note: Public official index overview, robots checked. Only one short attributed descriptive scope quotation retained for personal research, no licensed index feed, weighting export or PDF redistribution. Publication/effective date unknown; this is captured provider description, not dated valuation observation or historical membership proof.

excerpts.quote: The Nasdaq-100 Index® includes 100 of the largest domestic and international non-financial companies listed on The Nasdaq Stock Market based on market capitalization. The Index reflects companies across major industry groups including computer hardware and software, telecommunications, retail/wholesale trade and biotechnology. It does not contain securities of financial companies including investment companies.
